name: c_barrel
js: const sb=window.sandbox; const f=window.findFeat('barrel'); window._f=f; if(f){ sb.camOverride=(c,r)=>{c.position.set(f.x - f.tx*120 + f.ux*40 - f.tz*60, f.y + f.uy*40 + 20, f.z - f.tz*120 + f.uz*40 + f.tx*60);c.up.set(0,1,0);c.lookAt(f.x, f.y + 10, f.z);c.fov=60;c.updateProjectionMatrix();}; }
